Tata Motors will increase prices for its cars and SUVs by up to Rs 25,000. This price adjustment will affect both internal combustion engine and electric vehicle models. The company cites rising input and commodity costs as the primary reason for this decision. This move follows similar announcements made by other major automobile manufacturers.
